title: The Goblin Chase
cheer: Zap! The goblin scurries away from {spot}!
opening: Oh no! A sneaky goblin stole the Ice Crystal from the Crystal Cave, and that's why the mountain froze! Chase the goblin through the cave and zap it with fairy light until it gives the crystal back.
not_yet: Hee hee! The goblin isn't hiding there. Follow the clue!

steps.clue: Into the cave, careful and slow! The goblin's in the Icicle Tunnel, you know. Zap it before it runs away!
Pitter-patter, up it climbs! It's on the Rock Stairs, hopping in no time. Chase it to the very top!
Splish, splash! Down it goes, to the Glowworm Pool where the soft light glows. Zap it by the water's edge!
That silly goblin is dancing where the Ice Crystal used to stay. Hurry to the Crystal Pedestal before it slips away!
It ran home to its messy Nest, with socks and spoons and all the rest! One last zap to catch that goblin!

ending: Gotcha! The goblin says sorry and hands back the Ice Crystal. It shines on its pedestal again, and the whole mountain begins to thaw. You are the Goblin Catcher!
